name: stylecut
description: PERN stack salon website with services, products, pricing, and appointment booking.

scripts.dev:all: npm run stop:ports && concurrently "npm run dev:server" "npm run dev:client" "npm run dev:barber"
scripts.dev:client: npm install --prefix client-frontend && npm run dev --prefix client-frontend
scripts.dev:barber: npm install --prefix barber-frontend && npm run dev --prefix barber-frontend
scripts.dev:server: npm install --prefix server && npm run dev --prefix server
scripts.install:all: npm install && npm install --prefix server && npm install --prefix client-frontend && npm install --prefix barber-frontend
scripts.build:client: npm install --prefix client-frontend && npm run build --prefix client-frontend
scripts.build:barber: npm install --prefix barber-frontend && npm run build --prefix barber-frontend
scripts.build: npm run build:api && npm run build:client && npm run build:barber
